description:
IF: 

  • you are a senior accountant (minimum 2 years experience, CECCAR certification is an advantage) looking for a friendly working environment, a real and respectful team and international exposure trough information sharing across group members
  • your hard skills are:

- theoretical knowledge regarding the financial/ accounting activities and related legislation; SAP knowledge is an advantage

 - fluency in English (medium/advanced)

  • your soft skills are: precision, communication, prioritization, stress resistance

THEN YOU MAY BE INTERESTED IN THE POSITION OF SENIOR ACCOUNTANT WE ARE OFFERING WITHIN OUR FINANCE TEAM!

What would be your role?

The role of this position is to perform professional accounting. It requires knowledge of the theory and practice of examining and analyzing financial transactions in accordance with defined regulations.

We are looking for someone with deep knowledge in accounting, someone who likes to be in the middle of the figures and understands financial implications, someone who has the vision of all processes and knows to perform each of them correctly. Our future colleague is someone who understands the importance of rules, but always strives to improve processes.

Responsibilities

  • Correct application of the legislation in our company
  • Preparation of statements, balance sheet and other reports required by the legislation in force including monthly / quarterly / annual declarations, journals, financial statements to legal authorities, reports to BNR and IN Statistics
  • Knowledge of SAF-T and E-Factura
  • Month end closing and tax calculation (VAT, income tax), including checking the balance sheet positions,
  • Accounting postings (accruals and provisions, external invoices), sales orders for reinvoicing.
  • Preparation of documents for internal and external audits

 

Is it you? Then we definitely need to talk!

Come and join the team, building the future of Carmeuse company!

INTERESTED? SEND US YOUR APPLICATION!
